name: developer-detective
description: Narrative-driven learning platform for secure code review and ethical decision-making

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dd/shared && npm run build -w @dd/backend && npm run build -w @dd/frontend
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @dd/backend & npm run dev -w @dd/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @dd/backend && npm run test -w @dd/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @dd/backend && npm run lint -w @dd/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @dd/shared && npm run typecheck -w @dd/backend && npm run typecheck -w @dd/frontend && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e

engines.// node: 22.9 is the floor because the backend scripts use --env-file-if-exists, which does not exist before it
